授業概要
運動に対する身体の適応現象をヒト集団の現象として理解するために、講義や討論を行う。
また、ヒト集団データの解析方法についても解説する（SAS以外の統計ソフトは対象としない）。

To understand the phenomenon of the body's adaptive response to exercise as a human population, lectures and discussions will be conducted. In addition, the analysis methods of human population data will also be explained, focusing on statistical software such as SAS.

9-Causality

11-Statistical Methods Used in Exercise Epidemiology and Their Understanding (Part 1)
12-Statistical Methods Used in Exercise Epidemiology and Their Understanding (Part 2)
13-Statistical Methods Used in Exercise Epidemiology and Their Understanding (Part 3)
14-Research Implementation and Ethics
15-Summary and Explanation of the Test Required for Unit Certification.
